bulk.title: Add several resumes
bulk.intro: Choose up to {max} resume files that came from the same place. Each one becomes a draft candidate. Nothing is saved as a candidate until you open it, check the profile the AI proposes and confirm it.

import.title: Import candidates from a CSV
import.intro: For an export from another system or a spreadsheet. Choose the file, check which column is which, and import. People already in the agency (same email, phone or profile link) are skipped, not changed.
import.readError: The file could not be read as a CSV.
import.tooBig: The file is larger than 2 MB.
import.tooManyRows: The file has more than {max} rows. Split it and import in parts.
import.mappingHint: We guessed from the headings. Change any that are wrong; leave a column as "Do not import" to skip it.
import.needName: Choose a column for the name: either the full name, or the first name and the last name.
import.start: Import {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
import.summary: Finished: {created} added, {duplicates} already in the agency, {invalid} skipped.
import.duplicateLine: Row {row}: {name} is the same as an existing candidate ({reasons})
import.failed: The import stopped: {rows} rows were not sent. Rows already added stay. Check your connection and import the rest again; people already added are skipped.
